text: oh haha also, just noticed when i type into that search bar it hits the wasd map panning and moves around lol probably would hit other keybindings if my search item was right
resolution: Fixed the search-bar key leak at the root, in the engine's key dispatch gate (framework/engine.zig). Printable characters reach a focused text field via SDL_EVENT_TEXT_INPUT, so input.handleKey correctly returns false for the paired KEY_DOWN — but that keydown then fell through to the JS key bus (__ifttt_onKeyDown) and fired app hotkeys mid-typing: typing in the quick menu's skin search panned the world map through WASD, and any world single-key binding (R rotate, B place, Del delete...) would have fired the same way with the right search text. While a field is focused, a bare printable keydown now counts as consumed at the same gate that already swallows arrows/backspace; ctrl chords keep their existing routing untouched. This protects every text field in every cart, not just the search bar. Framework change verified end to end: zig ast-check clean and SHIP_RUN_PACKAGE=0 rjit ship editor compiles + links (exit 0) — the running dev host picks it up on its next rebuild-relaunch.
